checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'keyword-and-intent-research'.

checks.description: Research covers Arabic and English queries, Arabic-first, not literal translation.
checks.rule: Output produces ar and en queries side by side; English is parallel research, not a literal translation of the Arabic.

checks.description: Each query carries a search intent.
checks.rule: Each query is tagged informational, navigational, commercial, transactional, or generative.

checks.description: Generative (answer-engine) intent is a recognized intent alongside the classic four.
checks.rule: The intent tag set includes generative (answer-engine) for clusters worth pursuing for AI-answer citation rather than rank.

checks.description: Queries are grouped into clusters with one primary each and a priority.
checks.rule: Output groups queries into clusters with a primary_query and a priority of high, medium, or low.

checks.description: RTL is noted for Arabic queries.
checks.rule: Output notes RTL handling for Arabic queries so direction does not break.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name to justify a query.
checks.rule: Clusters reference only offers and titles traceable to the brief; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask, never invention or accreditation claims.
